title: Adding 0 turns the BLANK count of an empty RELATEDTABLE into 0
query: EVALUATE SELECTCOLUMNS ( Product, "Product", Product[Product], "Orders", COUNTROWS ( RELATEDTABLE ( Sales ) ) + 0 )

source.quote: When the table argument contains no rows, the function returns BLANK
source.supports: COUNTROWS of an empty table is BLANK
BLANK plus a number is the number

derivation: Counts are 3, 2, 2 and BLANK for Scooter. BLANK + 0 = 0; the others are unchanged. Whole number + whole number is a whole number.
